title: Lists and dictionaries
assignment: In 150 to 300 words, explain the difference between a list and a dictionary in Python. Give one example of a problem where you would pick each one, and say why.

criteria.name: concepts
criteria.label: Explains both structures
criteria.description: Correctly explains that a list is an ordered sequence read by position and a dictionary maps keys to values and is read by key. Names at least one practical difference, such as lookup by key versus by index.

criteria.name: examples
criteria.label: Examples with a reason
criteria.description: Gives one concrete problem for a list and one for a dictionary, and explains why that structure fits each problem.

criteria.name: clarity
criteria.label: Clarity
criteria.description: Written in the student's own words, organized, and easy to follow. Uses the terms correctly.
